title: Drunk Woman's Violent Rampage & Teen's Explosive Arrest!
description:
On May 21st, 2024, in Ohio, officers responded to a family dispute where a 30-year-old intoxicated woman assaulted another woman and caused property damage. The suspect resisted arrest, argued with deputies, and was eventually detained with backup assistance. She was charged with two counts of Domestic Violence and Resisting Arrest.

On January 14th, 2024, in Ohio, officers responded to a dispute involving an underage, intoxicated female attempting to enter a residence. Upon arrival, she was uncooperative, hostile, and attempted to strike an officer. After a struggle, she was detained and charged with Resisting Arrest and Disorderly Conduct.
